# stb_vorbis

(`MUSIC/TrackNN.ogg`).

- Source: https://github.com/nothings/stb, commit

- Licence: MIT or public domain (Unlicense), the user's choice; see the end

(third-party code is not held to the project's `-Werror` flags).
